Commentary.Commentary: We are back. Philip Salt and Dawid Malan to open for England. Tanvir Islam to bowl first.
...THE CHASE...

Bangladesh will be slightly disappointed but still have a par score on the board. They would have loved around 180 though. The way they started and way Litton Das and Najmul Hossain Shanto were punishing the bowlers the score was on but Das slowed down as he got past his fifty and since then, the runs were hard to buy for Bangladesh. The pitch has got demons but if one of England's batters go onto play a big innings, they should definitely chase this down.

Excellent recovery from England as at one point 180 was looking very gettable score but the way England bowled in the final phase, they deserved the praise. It could have been better if they started with the same energy. Sloppy fielding and drop catches didn't help them as Litton Das made the most of the lifeline while due to fielding, the pressure was never created. England though have given themselves a chance by pulling things back quite nicely.
JUST ONE! A yorker on off, Shanto plays it to square leg for a single. Bangladesh finish with 158.
DOT! Short and on leg, Shanto looks to pull but misses.
Too full and on leg, Al Hasan whips it to fine leg for a single. This is good bowling from Sam but needs to finish well.
A bouncer on middle. Al Hasan looks to pull but misses. England have reviewed this. UltraEdge shows no bat.
Outside off, Shanto strokes it to deep cover for a single.
Too full and on middle, Al Hasan nudges it to mid-wicket for a single.
Leg bye! Length and on leg. Al Hasan fails to scoop it away an gets hit on the pads. It rolls to fine leg for a leg bye.
On off, worked to cover for one.
Shanto survives again! Short and on off, this is pulled to deep square leg. Shanto himself pushes for the second. The fielder throws to Jos Buttler who removes the bails but Shanto was in.
Outside off, Shanto cuts it wide of deep point for two.

Najmul Hossain Shanto survives! Shanto is quick to review as he thinks that is down leg. A yorker, around leg. Shanto this time fails to flick and gets hit on the pads. No bat. Ball Tracking shows it is pitching outside the line. The decision has been overturned.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! A yorker on leg, Shanto goes back and whips it behind square leg.
Around off, Shanto punches it to deep cover for a single.
Excellent! Jofra Archer keeps it wide of off, Shanto chases but fails to hit it away.
On middle, chopped to point for a single.
Leg bye! Length and on middle. Shanto fails to heave and the ball falls back on the deck. Al Hasan calls for a single and makes his end.
Length and outside off, Al Hasan upper cuts it to third man just for one.
Full and onoff, Shanto flicked it to deep square leg for one.

OUT! TAKEN! The catch is taken! Can England build from here? Short and on off, Das pulls but holes out to deep mid-wicket as Philip Salt takes it. A fine innings from Das ends. He was struggling lately.
Commentary.Howout: c Philip Salt b Chris Jordan

Commentary.Commentary: This is superb bowling! A yorker, just outside off. Das fails to squeeze it out.
Very full and on off, Shanto jams it out to long on for a single.
This is full and outside off, Shanto looks to paddle but then later tries to scop over the keeper but misses.
Outside off, guided through point for one.
Full and on off, Shanto plays it through covers for a single.
Short and on off, pulled but finds square leg.
On middle, eased to long on for one.
On off, worked through covers for two.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
Fuller and across, outside off. Das flashes and misses.
Outside off, cut to point for a sharp single.
Outside off, worked to long off for a single.
Fuller and outside off, driven to deep cover for one.
Flat and outside off, kept out.
On middle, nudged to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! All the bowlers are getting the same treatment! Too full and outside off, Das knocks it over covers.
This is full and outside off, Shanto reverse hits it to deep point for one.
SIX! Jofra Archer shakes his head now! England are getting ripped apart! Short in length, outside off, pulled over mid-wicket for a six. 14 of this one.
FOUR! Jofra Archer can only smile now. Outside off, Das looks to pull but gets a top edge behind the keeper for four.
Short and on off, Shanto pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On off, kept out.
Outside off, guided to third man for a single.
Ben Duckett now drops it! Short and on off, Das pulls straight to deep mid-wicket where Ben Duckett lets a dolly down. Now what you see often from England. But they are looking completely different.
SIX! Again the boundary ruins the over! 10 off this over. 180 looks possible from here on. This is full and on off, Shanto tonks it over long on for a six.
Floated on middle. Das sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Fuller and outside off, Das reverse sweeps but finds short third man.
On middle, swept to deep square leg for a single.
Fifty for Das! Sublime knock so far from him! Full and on off, tucked to mid-wicket for a single. 100 up as well.
On middle, worked to mid-wicket for one.
Short and on middle, Das looks to pull but misses and gets hit on the helmet. A concussion protocol will go on.
FOUR! Two in a row! Das at his best! Fuller and outside off,Das shows full face of the bat and lofts it over mid off for four.
FOUR! Shot! Tad short and on off, Das pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Very full, outside off, Das fails to jam it out.
On off, kept out.
This is full and outside off, pushed to cover for one.
Outside off, Shanto reverse sweeps it to third man for one.
Flat and on leg, this one holds on. Shanto keeps it out.
Two more as this is flicked behind square on the leg side.
Outside off, cut to point for a couple.
SIX! BANG! First of the game! Too full and on middle. Shanto opens his body and smashes it over long on for a biggie.
On middle, swept to square leg for a single.
On the pads, tucked to square leg for one.
On middle, drilled to long on for a single.
Some concerns as Jos Buttler has a chat with the umpire. And now both umpires have a conversation. England probably wanted to change the field.
Wide! Free-hit stays! A bumper on middle, Shanto lets it go.
No ball! Length and on middle, pulled to square leg for one. More trouble for England as Sam Curran has overstepped. Free hit coming up.
Full and on middle, Shanto whips it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Goes full and on middle, eased to long on for one.
FOUR! That is cheeky! Length and outside off. Das opens the face of the bat and delicately places it past backward point for four.
On middle, pulled to square leg for one.
FOUR! England need to get better on the field! Too full on middle. Das makes room and jams it out to backward point. The fielder dives to his right but fails to stop.
Tossed up on off, Das works it to long off for a couple.
This one spins back in now. Das looks to reverse sweep but gloves it past the keeper and to short third man.
BEAUTY! Ahmed lands it around off, angling in before spinning away. Das looks to defend but is beaten.
This is full and on middle. Das on drives it to long on for a brace.
Fuller and outside off, Shanto strokes it through cover for one.
On middle, blocked out.
On off, kept out.
Drops it short and outside off, Snato punches it to deep point for one.

OUT! GONE! How badly England needed this wicket! Adil Rashid bowls it slow, flat and outside off. Talukdar looks to sweep but miscues it completely as the ball balloons back to Adil Rashid who takes a dolly. Buttler's decision to keep bowling Rashid gives the reward.
Fuller and outside off, Talukdar smashes it to deep cover. Philip Salt runs to his right, dives and saves two runs.
On off, kept out.
FOUR! The boundary ruins a good over! Nothing going as per England's plan! Outside off, this is slapped through covers for four.
This is full and outside off, Das looks to reverse sweep but misses again.
Quicker from Ahmed, full and outside off, Das looks to defend but misses.
Outside off, a googly, Talukdar knocks it to cover for one.
This is wide of off. Talukdar slashes and misses.
Outside off, pushed through covers for a couple.
Shorter and outside off, nips away. Das keeps it out.
On the hips, Talukdar tucks to square leg for a single. Das and Jofra Archer collide but that is fault of no one.
Full and on off, driven to mid off for a sharp single.

Jofra Archer is controlling his emotion, he wants to scream loudly after seeing the last two balls. Short and on off, Talukdar looks to pull but gets a top edge to shirt third man where Rehan Ahmed drops a sitter.
FOUR! Played so well! Short and on middle. Talukdar pulls it to deep mid-wicket. Ben Duckett runs to his left but fumbles to stop it. Need to do better.
This is full and around off, Das inside edges it to square leg for one.
Full and on off, defended out. Much better end to the over.
This one spins away, full and outside off. Talukdar looks to reverse sweep but misses.
Wide! Another goodly down the leg side, left alone.
A googly, full and outside off. Talukdar fails to read as he looks to sweep.
On middle, worked to square leg for a single.
FOUR! Boundaries keep on coming for Bangladesh! This is full and around off. Das sweeps it to square leg for four.
Flat and on middle, nudged to square leg for one.
Leg bye! Angling on the pads, Talukdar fails to tuck and it goes to square leg for a single.
On off, dropped to point for a single. The fielder has a shy at the batter's end but misses. Tell you what, he was a goner if that hit the stumps.
FOUR! Good shot! Das sees the short ball and sits back, he hits this over point and bags a boundary.
Wide! Too many wides from England already! Short and angling down. Das misses his pull shot.
Jofra Archer keeps it short and on middle, Talukdar pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Sharp bounce there. Short and on off, Talukdar punches it to cover.
Short in length and outside off, Talukdar looks to push but misses.
Tossed up on off, Das tucks it to mid on. Just 4 from it. Better from England.
Too full and on middle, Das leans and blocks.
On middle, kept out.
Wide! Very close! This one spins around leg, Das steps across to sweep but misses. There is sharp turn here.
Full and on middle, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Wide! This one goes down the leg side. Talukdar lets it go.
A quicker ball, around off, Das dabs it to point for a single.
Floated on off, Das keeps it out.
FOUR! 12 runs off the over! This is outside off on the shorter side, Talukdar slams it over mid off for a boundary.
Length and on off, tucked to mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, this is hit to deep square leg for a couple.
Length and on off, tails in and stays low. Das defends.
FOUR! Off the edge! Length and on middle. Das looks to paddle but gets a top edge behind the keeper and it races to the fence.
Around off, worked through covers for a single.
Chris Woakes to bowl from the other end.
Three dots to end the over! Length and outside off, tapped to point.
This one swings back in around off, Das defends it out.
On a length and on middle, blocked out.
Outside off, guided through covers for a single.
FOUR! Talukdar is off the mark as well! On the pads, this is flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Length ball, outside off, Das punches it to point and gets off the mark with a single.
Wide! Short in length and down leg. Das looks to flick but misses. Bangladesh are underway.
We are all set. The English players are out in the middle. Litton Das and Rony Talukdar to open for the home team. Sam Curran to bowl first! Let's play...
Shakib Al Hasan says it is a better wicket and is looking forward to put a decent score on the board. Adds they want to build on this momentum. Informs they have made two changes.

Jos Buttler says they will bowl first because it gives them a chance to win. Adds they bowled well in the last game and hopes to do the same. Reckons players need to take individual responsibility and play a big innings.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Litton Das (WK), Rony Talukdar, Najmul Hossain Shanto, Towhid Hridoy, Mehidy Hasan, Shakib Al Hasan (C), Shamim Hossain, Taskin Ahmed, Mustafizur Rahman, Hasan Mahmud, Tanvir Islam.
England (Playing XI) - Philip Salt, Dawid Malan, Moeen Ali, Jos Buttler (C/WK), Ben Duckett, Sam Curran, Chris Woakes, Chris Jordan, Rehan Ahmed, Adil Rashid, Jofra Archer.
Toss - England have won and they will bowl first.

Bangladesh have made the headlines recently by beating the reigning champions and are now looking to whitewash England at their home. This will be a massive boost to Bangladesh who lost the ODI series but have not looked back since then. England have a lot to think as this will dump their belief slightly. Now that the series has gone from their hands, they will hope to win the final match and end the series on a high. The Dhaka pitch showed how difficult it was to bat, expect similar outcome today as well. Welcome to the coverage. Toss and team news coming up..
...MATCH DAY...

It is now time for the third and final T20I between Bangladesh and England at the Shere Bangla National Stadium in Dhaka and it is also the final game of the white-ball series. The visitors England won the first two ODIs to take an unassailable lead in the three-game series but Bangladesh did win the final game and carried the momentum into the T20I series, taking an unassaiable 2-0 lead themselves. The hosts have a stellar white-ball record at home and they have been able to tame the T20 World Champions without much of a fuss. It was a well-contested first T20I with England surpassing 150 runs thanks to a solid knock by skipper Jos Buttler. It was though chased down with a couple of overs remaining via a all-round batting effort led by Najmul Hossain Shanto. England came into the second game needing a win but they batted first again and this time Bangladesh were even stringer with ball in hand. Mehidy Hasan picked up four wickets to keep the visitors down to a modest score of 117. The visitors too bowled well and Jofra Archer was able to pick up wickets but the hosts manged to notch up a four-wicket win with an over remaining. Mehidy Hasan scored 20 crucial runs to round off a stellar display. Given the fact that England are the reigning T20 World Champions and have a competitive side, they will fight hard to end the tour with a win. Whereas Bangladesh will be eyeing a whitewash against a quality side at home. Which side will come out on top? We shall find out.
